title: Multiplication and division of integers
competency: Multiply and divide integers, and use the commutative, associative and distributive properties.

keywords.def: A number being multiplied. In 3 × 5, 3 and 5 are factors.
The number being divided. In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, 12 is the dividend.
The number you divide by. In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, 3 is the divisor.
The answer to a division. In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, 4 is the quotient.

en.text: Multiplication is repeated addition: 4 times minus 5 is minus 5 added four times, which is minus 20. Same signs give a positive product. Different signs give a negative product. Multiply the sizes, then put the sign in front.

screens.title: Repeated addition
screens.after:
Add −5 four times: −5 + (−5) = −10, then −15, then −20.
So 4 × (−5) = −20.
20 has the wrong sign. −9 is −5 + (−4), an addition, not a product.
A positive times a negative is negative.

A positive times a negative gives a negative product.

en.text: Multiplication of integers is commutative and associative. It also distributes over addition: a times b plus c equals a times b plus a times c. Any integer times zero is zero, and any integer times one is itself.

screens.title: Swap the order
screens.after:
21 × (−3): opposite signs, so negative. 21 × 3 = 63. So −63.
−3 × 21: opposite signs, so negative. Also −63.
Changing the order does not change a product. This is the commutative property.

screens.title: Properties of multiplication
screens.ask: Tap each property to see the rule and an example.

screens.text: Properties of multiplication: which property is 2 × (−3 + 54) = (2 × (−3)) + (2 × 54)?
screens.why:
Look at the shape: a × (b + c) = (a × b) + (a × c).
Here a = 2, b = −3 and c = 54.
The 2 is shared out over the bracket.
That is the distributive property. The order and the grouping did not change.
screens.clue: Is a bracket being shared out?

screens.why:
−525 × 955 = 955 × (−525): the order swapped. Commutative.
2 × (−13 × 5) = (2 × (−13)) × 5: the brackets moved. Associative.
5 × 1 = 5: times 1 changes nothing. Property of 1.
0 × (−8) = 0: times 0 gives 0. Property of zero.
screens.clue: Order swapped, brackets moved, times 1, or times 0?
screens.text: Properties of multiplication: match each statement with its property.

screens.ask: Use the brackets or the distributive property: −6 × (5 + 2) = ___
screens.why:
Way 1: bracket first. 5 + 2 = 7. Then −6 × 7 = −42.
Way 2: share −6 out: (−6 × 5) + (−6 × 2).
−30 + (−12) = −42.
Both ways give −42.
screens.clue: Do the bracket first, or share −6 out.

screens.why:
Left side: 3 + 7 = 10, and −5 × 10 = −50.
Right side: −5 × 3 = −15, and −5 + 2 = −3.
−15 + (−3) = −18.
−50 ≠ −18, so the statement is false.

Both products share the factor −5.
Distributive property backwards: (−5 × 98) + (−5 × 2) = −5 × (98 + 2).
98 + 2 = 100.
−5 × 100 = −500.

en.text: Count the negative factors. An even number of negative factors gives a positive product. An odd number gives a negative product. If any factor is zero, the product is zero.

screens.title: Count the minuses
screens.after:
−1 × (−1) = +1: two negatives give a positive.
+1 × (−1) = −1.
So −1 × (−1) × (−1) = −1.
Three negatives, an odd number, give a negative product.

screens.title: Products with many factors
paras: An even number of negative factors gives a positive product.
An odd number of negative factors gives a negative product.
If at least one factor is 0, the product is 0.
Multiplying by −1 gives the opposite: −1 × a = −a.

screens.title: Count the negatives
items: Three negative factors: odd. The product is −24.
Four negative factors: even. The product is 1.

screens.text: Sign of a product: what is the sign of (−125) × (−3) × (−52)?
screens.why:
Count the negative factors: −125, −3, −52. That is 3.
3 is odd.
An odd number of negative factors gives a negative product.
No factor is 0, so the answer is not zero.

Count the negatives: 2, an even number. So the product is positive.
Multiply two at a time: 9 × (−3) = −27.
−27 × (−6) = 162.
So the product is 162.

Count the negatives: 5, an odd number. So the product is negative.
Multiply the sizes: 1 × 2 = 2, 2 × 3 = 6, 6 × 4 = 24, 24 × 5 = 120.
So the product is −120.

One of the factors is 0.
Any number times 0 is 0.
So the whole product is 0. No other working is needed.

screens.text: Spot the mistake: the book writes −5 × (−5) × 3 × (−8) = 600. Is that right?
screens.why:
Count the negative factors: −5, −5, −8. That is 3, an odd number.
So the product must be negative.
−5 × (−5) = 25. 3 × (−8) = −24.
25 × (−24) = −600.
So 600 is wrong; the answer is −600.

en.text: Division undoes multiplication: 12 divided by 3 is 4 because 4 times 3 is 12. Same signs give a positive quotient; different signs give a negative quotient. You can never divide by zero. Zero divided by a non-zero number is zero.

screens.title: Use the product
screens.after:
Division undoes multiplication. Ask: what times 9 gives −36?
−4 × 9 = −36.
So −36 ÷ 9 = −4.
4 has the wrong sign. −45 is −36 − 9, a subtraction.

screens.title: Division of integers
paras: Division is the inverse of multiplication.
In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, 12 is the dividend, 3 the divisor and 4 the quotient.
a ÷ b = c means a = b × c, with b ≠ 0. a ÷ b is also written a/b.

screens.title: Properties of division
items: Not defined: a/0 has no answer.

screens.why:
Step 1: the sign. 24 and −4 have different signs, so the quotient is negative.
Step 2: the sizes: 24 ÷ 4 = 6.
So 24 ÷ (−4) = −6.
Check: −4 × (−6) = 24. ✓
screens.clue: Different signs give a negative quotient.

screens.why:
Step 1: the sign. −130 and 5 have different signs, so the quotient is negative.
Step 2: the sizes: 130 ÷ 5 = 26.
So −130 ÷ 5 = −26. Check: 5 × (−26) = −130. ✓

Step 1: the sign. Both are negative, so the quotient is positive.
Step 2: the sizes: 40 ÷ 5 = 8.
So −40 ÷ (−5) = 8. Check: −5 × 8 = −40. ✓

768 ÷ 0 = ? would mean ? × 0 = 768.
But any number times 0 is 0, never 768.
So there is no answer. Division by zero is not defined.
0 is the answer to 0 ÷ 768, not to 768 ÷ 0.

screens.ask: Divide integers (the answer can be a decimal): −37 ÷ (−2) = ___
screens.why:
Step 1: the sign. Both are negative, so the quotient is positive.
Step 2: 37 ÷ 2 = 18 remainder 1.
Step 3: 1 ÷ 2 = 0.5, so 37 ÷ 2 = 18.5.
So −37 ÷ (−2) = 18.5.
screens.clue: The quotient can be a decimal.

screens.why:
Turn it into a product: −1092 = 14 × ___.
The quotient 14 is positive, so dividend and divisor have the same sign.
The dividend is negative, so the divisor is negative.
Size: 1092 ÷ 14 = 78. So the divisor is −78.
Check: −1092 ÷ (−78) = 14. ✓

steps: Different signs: take the sign of the bigger size, then subtract the sizes.

items.text: Properties of multiplication: name the property 2 × (−13 × 5) = (2 × (−13)) × 5
items.why:
The factors stay in the same order: 2, −13, 5.
Only the brackets move.
That is the associative property.
Commutative would swap the order.

items.ask: Substitute and multiply: a = −6, b = −8, c = −12. a × (b × c) = ___
items.why:
Step 1: b × c = −8 × (−12). Both negative, so positive: 96.
Step 2: a × 96 = −6 × 96. Opposite signs, so negative.
6 × 96 = 576. So the answer is −576.
Check: three negative factors, odd, so negative. ✓

items.text: Sign of a product: find the sign of 12 × (−50) × (−61).
items.why:
Count the negative factors: −50 and −61. That is 2.
2 is even.
An even number of negative factors gives a positive product.

items.text: Parts of a division: in −96 ÷ 12 = −8, which number is the divisor?
items.why:
The dividend is the number being divided: −96.
The divisor is the number you divide by: 12.
The quotient is the answer: −8.
So the divisor is 12.

items.ask: Divide integers (the answer can be a decimal): 45 ÷ (−4) = ___
items.why:
Step 1: the sign. Different signs, so the quotient is negative.
Step 2: 45 ÷ 4 = 11 remainder 1.
Step 3: 1 ÷ 4 = 0.25, so 45 ÷ 4 = 11.25.
Answer: −11.25.

test.text: Properties of multiplication: which property is −2 × 5 = 5 × (−2)?
test.why:
The two factors swap places.
Nothing else changes.
Changing the order is the commutative property.

Count the negatives: −4 and −3. That is 2, even. So positive.
−4 × 5 = −20.
−20 × (−3) = 60.

test.ask: Divide integers (the answer can be a decimal): −150 ÷ (−20) = ___
test.why:
Both are negative, so the quotient is positive.
150 ÷ 20 = 7 remainder 10.
10 ÷ 20 = 0.5, so 150 ÷ 20 = 7.5.
Answer: 7.5.
